#include <bits/stdc++.h>

using namespace std;

using ll = long long;
using vi = vector<int>;
using db = double;
#define pb push_back
#define fir first
#define sec second

int n, k, mod;
int f[250006][27];

inline int lowbit(int x) { return x & -x; }

const int MAX_N = 250001;
int fac[MAX_N], inv[MAX_N], ifac[MAX_N];

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    cin >> n >> k >> mod;
    
    inv[1] = fac[0] = fac[1] = ifac[0] = ifac[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i < MAX_N; ++i) {
        inv[i] = (ll)(mod - mod / i) * inv[mod % i] % mod;
        fac[i] = (ll)fac[i - 1] * i % mod;
        ifac[i] = (ll)ifac[i - 1] * inv[i] % mod;
    }
    
    ll total = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
        total = total * k % mod;
    
    ll ans = total;
    if (n % 2 == 0) {
        f[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            if ((n & i) != i) continue;
            for (int msk = i - lowbit(i), j = msk; ; j = (j - 1) & msk) {
                int len = min(k - 1, __builtin_popcount(j));
                for (int t = 0; t <= len; ++t) {
                    f[i][t + 1] = (f[i][t + 1] + (ll)f[j][t] * ifac[i - j]) % mod;
                }
                if (!j) break;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; ++i) {
            ans = (ans - (ll)f[n][i] * fac[n] % mod * fac[k] % mod * ifac[k - i]) % mod;
        }
    }
    
    cout << (ans % mod + mod) % mod << '\n';
    
    return 0;
}
